## Your Schengen visa application

I’ve used 8–13 March 2027 as your intended travel dates. If your itinerary differs from the fair dates, enter the dates you actually plan to enter and leave the Schengen area.

| Blank | Entry | What to do by hand |
|---|---|---|
| B01 Surname | RAGHUNATHAN | |
| B02 Surname at birth | NEEDS-YOU | Confirm your surname at birth and any former family names. |
| B03 Given name | VIKRAM | Enter your given names together in the single blank, in the order shown in your passport. Include your middle name if it appears among the passport’s given names. |
| B03 Middle name | ANAND | |
| B04 Date of birth | 22/11/1983 | If needed, rewrite the restored date in day-month-year order. |
| B05 Place of birth | PUNE, MAHARASHTRA | |
| B06 Country of birth | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your country of birth. |
| B07 Current nationality | Indian | |
| B07 Nationality at birth | NEEDS-YOU | Enter it only if it differs from your current nationality. |
| B07 Other nationalities | NEEDS-YOU | Enter any other nationalities you hold. |
| B08 Sex | Male | Tick Male. |
| B09 Civil status | Married | Tick Married. |
| B10 Parental authority or guardian | Leave blank | |
| B11 National identity number | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your national identity number directly on the form if applicable. |
| B12 Travel document type | NEEDS-YOU | Confirm the passport category and tick the corresponding box. |
| B13 Travel document number | Z4827163 | |
| B14 Date of issue | 05/06/2019 | If the form requires a different date format, rewrite the restored date by hand. |
| B15 Valid until | 04-06-2029 | |
| B16 Issued by | India | |
| B17 Qualifying family member’s details | Leave blank unless applicable | Complete this section if you have a qualifying family member described in field 17. |
| B18 Relationship to qualifying family member | Leave blank unless applicable | If field 17 applies, tick the corresponding relationship. |
| B19 Home address | 14 Quillon Mews, Didsbury, Manchester M20 6QX, United Kingdom | Add your email address in the same blank. |
| B19 Email address | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your email address. |
| B19 Telephone | +44 7700 900123 | |
| B20 Residence outside India | Yes — UK residence permit | Tick Yes. |
| B20 Residence permit number | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the permit number directly on the form. |
| B20 Residence permit valid until | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the permit expiry date. |
| B21 Current occupation | Software engineer | |
| B22 Employer | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your employer’s name, address and telephone number. |
| B23 Purpose of journey | Business | Tick Business. |
| B24 Additional information | Attending a trade fair in Munich, Germany, from 8 to 13 March 2027. | |
| B25 Main destination | Germany | Add any other Schengen destinations on your itinerary, if applicable. |
| B26 Member State of first entry | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the Schengen country where you first cross the external border on your itinerary. |
| B27 Number of entries | NEEDS-YOU | Select the number of entries you are requesting. |
| B28 Intended arrival | 08-03-2027 | |
| B29 Intended departure | 13-03-2027 | |
| B30 Previous fingerprints | Yes | Tick Yes. Leave the exact date blank since you only know the year. |
| B30 Previous visa sticker number | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the sticker number if known. |
| B31 Entry permit for final destination | Leave blank for the stated itinerary | |
| B32 Inviting person or accommodation | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the inviting person’s name or, if applicable, the name of your hotel or other accommodation. |
| B33 Inviting person or accommodation contact details | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the address, email address and telephone number for the entry in B32. |
| B34 Inviting company or organisation | NEEDS-YOU | Enter its name and address if a company or organisation invited you. |
| B35 Inviting company or organisation contact details | NEEDS-YOU | If B34 applies, enter the contact person’s full name, address, telephone number and email address, plus the organisation’s telephone number. |
| B36 Who covers the costs | By a sponsor — your employer | Tick the sponsor box. If your employer is listed in field 30 or 31, tick that reference. Otherwise, tick Other and enter your employer’s name. |
| B36 Sponsor name and means of support | NEEDS-YOU | Use your employer’s name where required and tick the means of support that match what it will cover. |
| B37 Person filling in the form | Leave blank if you complete it yourself | |
| B38 Form preparer’s contact details | Leave blank if you complete it yourself | |
| B39 Place and date | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the place and date of signing. |
| B40 Applicant’s signature | NEEDS-YOU | Sign the form yourself. Leave the parental authority or guardian signature blank. |
